Class ClientMainCli

java.lang.Object
network.client.core.cli.ClientMainCli
public class ClientMainCli extends Object
Entry point and interactive driver for the text (CLI) client. It collects the transport configuration and player name from stdin, opens a VirtualServer, then runs the read-eval loop that parses console commands and forwards them to the server. Inbound server events are rendered by ClientStateListenerCli on the reader thread.

    • startGame

      private static void startGame(ClientMainCli.ConnectionConfig config) throws Exception
      Starts the game with the given configuration.

      Opens the transport, then loops on the player-name prompt until the server accepts the name. Only after acceptance are the local game state, listener, reader thread and heartbeat scheduler created and started.

      Parameters:
      config - the transport configuration to connect with
      Throws:
      Exception - if connecting or starting the session fails

    • dispatch

      private static boolean dispatch(VirtualServer proxy, String input)
      This is a simple command dispatcher that parses the first word as the command and the rest as an argument. It calls the appropriate method on the VirtualServer proxy based on the command.
      Parameters:
      proxy - virtual server associated to the client
      input - command string took from CLI
      Returns:
      false if the command is unknown, true otherwise
